summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execute-phase 'ship loop' for GSD phase 69 (FUSE/WinFsp Rust integration + grant-root awareness) — verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit review, ship as a PR, resolve all review threads, and extract learnings — with minimal user babysitting.
summary.outcome: PR #594 was opened with a conventional title; all CI checks (including cargo-windows after the user pushed the missing plan 69-14 winfsp work) went green; all 9 review threads (6 Greptile + 3 CodeRabbit) were triaged and resolved with 10 verified-safe code fixes applied (incl. a CRITICAL read-after-write EIO regression) and 3 risky/out-of-scope items deferred to todos; 69-LEARNINGS.md was generated; only the final Desktop E2E matrix run remained pending before handing the merge decision to the user.

repo: cipher-box squash-merges PRs, so branch commit subjects never reach release-please post-merge — only the PR title needs to be conventional/paren-free; rewriting merged commit history (git filter-branch) is unnecessary and risky.
pr-release-preview.js's commit regex captures the description as '.+' (tolerates parens) and skips merge commits; it only fails on the legacy 'feat NN-NN:' space-separated subject format.
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL; patch PR bodies via `gh api -X PATCH repos/.../pulls/<N> -F body=@file`.
github-actions[bot] pushes a chore(release) commit after gh pr create and a passing Release Preview — must git fetch + rebase/merge before any further push or it's rejected.
The commit helper can report commit_failed while the commit actually lands (1Password SSH signing hang false negative) — verify with `git log --oneline -1` before retrying.
CodeRabbit CLI times out summarizing very large diffs (125 files/~24k lines); scope with `--dir <path>` per top-level directory to get real findings instead of a timeout.
CodeRabbit CLI free tier rate-limits repeated scoped invocations (~46 min cooldown) — fall back to the PR-level review for directories hit by the limit.

Plan 69-14 (WinFsp Windows platform layer) is intentionally unexecuted locally (autonomous:false, D-06) because that code doesn't compile under local macOS cargo; only the CI cargo-windows job can validate it.
GraphQL reviewThreads query (id, isResolved, path, line, first comment body) is required to see CodeRabbit/Greptile inline findings — the PR review body alone misses them.
macOS Desktop E2E has a known flaky termination pattern (exit 4 / 'Terminated: 15') after several minutes of otherwise-successful operations, distinct from a real assertion failure.
.planning/ is excluded from markdownlint in CI but not from prettier, and existing markdownlint nits in .planning/*-PLAN.md tables are non-blocking noise safe to resolve-without-fixing.

code.finding: is_unresolved was structurally identical to the enclosing cid.is_empty() check, making the pending_content/empty-file fallback unreachable and causing read-after-write to return EIO; fixed by serving pending_content at the top of the empty-CID block and letting handle_open succeed for pending-write files.
InodeKind's derived Debug leaked key material via Zeroizing's forwarding Debug impl; replaced with a manual redacting Debug implementation.

fetch_node_gated's own-resolve path feeds the stored floor as both the 'attempted' and comparison generation (a floor-vs-floor no-op check) — confirmed by design, not a bypass, because the (seq, CID) pair is IPNS-signature-bound and generation is separately AEAD-AAD-bound; matches the ported TS twin's Pitfall-3 rule.
Legacy v2 vault blobs are now rejected fail-closed with no backward-compat shim, intentionally, per plan 69-19's clean flag-day cutover assumption (no production v2 vaults exist).
The CAS publish loop left an uploaded content CID pinned on early '?' failure returns; fixed by wrapping the loop to best-effort unpin the CID on every failure path.
TEE enrollment match ran after upload_content, so a wrap failure would leave an already-pinned blob; hoisted the enrollment check above the upload.
Added deny_unknown_fields to node decode structs for fail-closed hardening; confirmed safe since the encoder emits exactly those fields and KAT vectors still pass.

workflow: For CI-gated, non-conversational phases, the interactive /gsd-verify-work UAT flow doesn't fit — generating the goal-backward VERIFICATION.md directly (via a verifier subagent fed real test evidence) is the right substitute.

Run heavy build/test suites (cargo test --workspace) centrally as the orchestrator in the background, not inside parallel subagents, to avoid RAM contention while a verifier/auditor subagent works concurrently.

When a security/audit subagent stalls mid-stream after several minutes rather than re-spawning a stall-prone long-running agent, it's faster and more reliable to assemble the report directly from already-gathered data (parsed threat register + verified SC mitigations + test evidence).

Route every crypto/security-adjacent code-review finding through parallel adversarial-verification subagents before applying fixes — this caught several false positives (e.g., a 'fix' that would have broken write-generation desync protection) that would have caused regressions if blindly applied.

Defer risky, large, or not-yet-live-feature findings into structured todo files (.planning/todos/pending/) rather than fixing them under ship-loop time pressure; expand existing related todos instead of creating near-duplicates.

friction: Initial git switch failed because the target branch was already checked out in a separate worktree (cipher-box-phase69); required verifying cleanliness and removing the worktree first.
The /gsd-verify-work skill is built for conversational human UAT and didn't fit an autonomous CI-gated Rust phase — had to bypass it and hand-drive goal-backward verification.
The gsd-security-auditor subagent stalled mid-stream (API error) after ~7.5 minutes of work, forcing manual reconstruction of the SECURITY.md report from raw data instead of a clean auditor handoff.
CodeRabbit CLI timed out on the full 125-file/24k-line diff, requiring a fallback to per-directory scoped reviews.
CodeRabbit CLI hit a rate limit on the apps/desktop scope (46-minute cooldown), leaving that area only covered by the later PR-level review.
Commit operations twice appeared to time out/fail (1Password SSH signing hang) even though the commits actually landed, requiring manual git log verification instead of blind retries.
A background poll script failed because zsh treats $status as a read-only reserved variable, requiring a rewrite with a different variable name.
GraphQL mutations for replying to/resolving PR review threads failed silently on first attempts due to GitHub API flakiness, requiring a rerun with visible error output and a retry loop.

The cargo-windows CI gate failed with 47 compile errors, initially appearing to block SC#5, but turned out to be caused by the user's not-yet-pushed plan 69-14 winfsp work rather than anything in the ship-review changes.

The macOS Desktop E2E leg failed via timeout/termination after 5 minutes of otherwise-successful operations, consistent with a known FUSE-T flake rather than a real regression, requiring log digging to distinguish the two.
